components.name: LayeredTeachingApplication
components.purpose: Keep domain rules independent from HTTP, persistence, authentication, and providers
invariants: domain has no Flask or SQLite imports

components.name: AuthenticatedLearnerProfiles
components.purpose: Expose authentication state and isolate progress by opaque learner profile

components.name: TeacherRuntimeConfiguration
components.purpose: Discover, validate, persist, and expose the selected teacher model

components.name: CodexSdkGateway
components.purpose: Call an authenticated direct Codex SDK with multimodal inputs, tool continuation, final-answer extraction, and deterministic cleanup
invariants: active images are bounded to the upload root
tool calls continue until a final answer

components.name: CodexAuthentication
components.purpose: Manage recoverable browser and device-code login state and opaque learner cookies

components.name: CodexLoginRoutes
components.purpose: Expose authentication, callback, completion, logout, model discovery, and model selection routes

components.name: SSEStateChannel
components.purpose: Push versioned state changes and preserve open tracker context with automatic polling fallback

components.name: TeacherGateway
components.purpose: Use an authenticated broker when a direct SDK is unavailable

components.name: TeacherJob
components.purpose: Run reviews and questions outside the request thread with strict review parsing and evidence audits

components.name: DurableAutomationRecovery
components.purpose: Resume pending reviews, questions, and lesson generations after restart

components.name: ValidatedUploads
components.purpose: Validate images and PDFs and preserve exact failed-revision evidence semantics

components.name: TeacherAnswerRenderer
components.purpose: Render Markdown, TeX, and constrained SVG safely

components.name: CurriculumPolicy
components.purpose: Validate the complete lesson and summative-assessment plan contract

components.name: PlanDrivenGeneration
components.purpose: Select, hash, validate, and reuse plan-owned lesson artifacts

components.name: LessonGraphRevisionWorkflow
components.purpose: Replace exactly one lesson SVG after authenticated screenshot-backed generation and independent validation

components.name: ProgressPolicy
components.purpose: Keep streak, level, achievement, and completion rules outside presentation code

components.name: TeachingContractTests
components.purpose: Prove curriculum, submission, review, generation, authentication, upload, graph, progress, and realtime invariants
invariants: one real smoke test remains opt-in
